_meta.excerpt_rule: 25 rows in trail order: 21 stage rows + the 4 cite-check routing rows. Population: the slice-map publisher (4), the plan publish (20) plus its in-place republishes via plan-fix/code-fix (32/55), all four cite-check floor rows (21/33/47/56), and every verdict row published to plan-verdicts/code-verdicts before the last decision that reads its channel (plan panel 22-26, plan confirms 28-30, code panel 48-52). Excluded: post-fold publishers (second panels 34-38 and 57-61 land after the last fold reading their channel), demote rows (27/39/53/62 - publish no channel entry), snapshot/splice rows (no fold reads their channels), and every row outside stages 4-56.
_meta.channel_rule: Each stage row bakes its outcome channel in `channel` (derived from the workflow's outcome map so the replay needs no workflow introspection): slice->slices; plan/plan-fix/code-fix->plans; plan-cite-check->plan-cite-check; code-cite-check->code-cite-check; plan-grade/plan-confirm->plan-verdicts; code-grade->code-verdicts.
_meta.trim_rule: Stage rows keep stageNumber/stage/channel plus output.artifacts (fs handle paths verbatim) and fold-read output.data fields only: slices keeps slice_count (gateTier); plans keeps phase_count (gateTier) and risks[] trimmed to id/claim_type/disposition/procedure/owner (planAuthoredRisks + evidence duties; claim prose dropped); floor rows keep dimension/pass/severity (allDimensionsPass); verdict rows keep dimension/pass/severity/artifact (freshVerdicts basename match) and risk_rulings[] trimmed to id/pass/evidence (rulingEffectivePass/evidenceCitesFileLine). Dropped: findings/feedback/score/kind/meta/ts - no fold reads them, and no excerpted verdict is all-anchor-nit, so dropping findings preserves every fold. Routing rows keep type/fromStage/decision verbatim.
_meta.row_format: compact one-row-per-line JSON (each rows[] element on a single line)
